summary: This is a routine 8-K filing by Advanced Drainage Systems, Inc. to report its fourth-quarter and fiscal-year 2026 unaudited results, provide supplemental presentation slides via Regulation FD, and announce a $0.20/share cash dividend approved by the Board for June 2026. No M&A, activist, restructuring or other special-situation activity is disclosed. The filing contains no deal terms, strategic review, tender, or spin-off elements. It is an ordinary earnings and dividend announcement with no event-driven or special-situations catalyst.
